about: The falsifier: the regions a view could ask were a list kept by hand on the wire, audit/wire/regions, and a region no line of it named refused its view even where a capsule rendered it. At epoch 265 the list refused view/entry at topos-doc, topos-frame, topos-github and topos-node, and verify's three workflow views that ask github-actions, so none of those pages was written, and every region a capsule adds waits on an owner line.

cases.name: view/entry at four capsule places, and view/pipeline-release, -tag, -test at verify, epoch 265
cases.said: names regions the wire does not list
cases.rendered by: a capsule each place can run
